dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: improvement notice - material unwanted event control at PSV-7103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-7103 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-7103 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 4 March 2024 a regulatory notice was issued concerning PSV-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal following commissioning of replacement equipment.
